headline: Palace boss: Expect Ismaïla Sarr to stay amid reported Liverpool interest
description: Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage has said that he expects Ismaila Sarr to stay at the club, amid reports linking the winger to Liverpool.

headline: Man United's Bruno Fernandes eager to 'make it right' against Ipswich
description: Bruno Fernandes is determined to "make it right" against Ipswich and belatedly begin Manchester United's push to better last season's third-place finish having been given a bloody nose at Hull.

headline: David Raya: Arsenal 'confident we can beat anybody at any time'
description: David Raya says Arsenal want to become serial winners after ending their 22-year wait for a Premier League title.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona, Man United to hold Balde talks
description: Manchester United are set to open negotiations with Barcelona over the signing of defender Alejandro Balde. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Tottenham agree Omar Marmoush loan with Man City - sources
description: Tottenham have agreed a season-long loan deal with Manchester City for forward Omar Marmoush with an obligation to buy for £60 million ($82m) next year, sources have told ESPN.
